title: Dance Around The World
description: Thirty dance styles — breaking, samba, voguing, tinikling, K-pop, lion dance — as a one-tap pixel-art rhythm game. Every dancer, stage, song and sound effect is AI-generated, extracted into spritesheets by a Python pipeline and played by one shared JavaScript engine. Runs in any browser, no install.

title: FABLE
description: A generative audiovisual poem in five movements — a 262k-particle nebula, GPU fluid dynamics, a 40,000-bird murmuration, a raymarched fractal tunnel and a spiral galaxy, scored live by a procedural music engine. One HTML file, zero dependencies, written by Claude Fable 5.

title: Abalone
description: A polished 3D rendition of the classic marble-pushing board game with multiple camera angles, move previews, and complete rule enforcement.

title: Piano Studio
description: 3D piano studio with MIDI playback, waterfall note visualisation, multiple camera angles, and tempo controls.

title: Drumset Studio
description: Interactive 3D drum kit with realistic stick and ghost-hand motion, studio-quality drum samples, patterns, performances, and hundreds of full Groove MIDI songs.

title: Live Earth
description: Real-time global monitoring dashboard with live data feeds for flights, earthquakes, weather, ocean conditions, space activity, and more.

title: Brighton Hub
description: Live city dashboard for Brighton & Hove with real-time transport, environment, crime, housing, health, events, and schools data.
